tasks.title: Read PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE/PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY and fetch the origin remote during sync
steps: Write TS-02-1..TS-02-8 in internal/carrypatch/sync_extension_test.go (or a new sync_origin_test.go), extending the mock env in testhelpers_test.go with a recording OriginFetch stub and a way to assert wslock is held while it runs; confirm all fail

Add a fetch helper in a new internal/carrypatch/origin_fetch.go: DefaultOriginFetchFunc() FetchFunc that opens the repo with git.PlainOpen, resolves the origin remote, and calls FetchContext with RefSpecs []config.RefSpec{"+refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*"} and Tags: git.NoTags, treating errors.Is(err, git.NoErrAlreadyUpToDate) as success -- mirror internal/upstream/upstream.go's Fetch exactly
Add OriginFetch FetchFunc and ResolveOriginAuth ResolveAuthFunc fields to SyncAPIConfig in api.go
Add OriginFetched bool (json origin_fetched) to CarryPatchSyncResponse in api.go and include it in asExtras() in sync_handlers.go

In runCarryPatchSync (sync_handlers.go), immediately after the existing upstream Fetch call succeeds, read patchBranchSource fresh via cfg.GetVariable("workspace", slug, "PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE") on every call (never cache across syncs); treat anything other than the exact string "origin" as "hub"

When patchBranchSource is origin: resolve origin auth via cfg.ResolveOriginAuth(slug) (skip if nil), then call cfg.OriginFetch(ctx, repoPath, auth) while still holding the sync's wslock; on error return apikit.WriteAPIError(c, http.StatusBadGateway, "origin fetch failed") without having written upstream_head_sha/last_sync_at/any patch row yet, and set resp.OriginFetched=true only once this call returns nil

Only when patchBranchSource is origin, read PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY via cfg.GetVariable("workspace", slug, "PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY"); anything other than the exact string "report" resolves to "replace"; do not call GetVariable for it at all in hub mode
When patchBranchSource is hub, skip the origin fetch and divergence-policy read entirely and leave resp.OriginFetched=false
Update main.go's carrypatch.SyncAPIConfig{} literal to wire OriginFetch: carrypatch.DefaultOriginFetchFunc() and ResolveOriginAuth: a closure calling workspace.ResolveCloneAuth(store, slug)

In docs/carry_patch_workflow.md's Configuration section, add a PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE and a PATCH_DIVERGENCE_POLICY subsection each with a value table, mirroring the existing AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC subsection's style
Run go test ./internal/carrypatch/... -count=1 until TS-02-1..TS-02-8 pass

tasks.title: Bring each registered patch branch to the fork's tip and persist the outcome
steps: Write TS-02-9..TS-02-16 and TS-02-27 and confirm they fail

Define a patchSyncOutcome struct in a new internal/carrypatch/fork_refresh.go: BranchName, Action (none|created|fast_forwarded|replaced), State (in_sync|diverged|missing_on_origin|empty), LocalSHA, OriginSHA, ReplacedSHA

Add refreshPatchBranchesFromOrigin(ctx, git GitRunner, patches []Patch, integrationBranch, divergencePolicy string) (outcomes []patchSyncOutcome, patchAdvanced bool) that, in position order, considers only patches with Status active/conflict/disabled (skip merged_upstream, deleted, and any patch whose BranchName equals integrationBranch)

For each considered patch: rev-parse --verify refs/remotes/origin/<branch> (missing -> record state missing_on_origin, no write); rev-parse --verify refs/heads/<branch> (missing locally -> git.Run(ctx, "update-ref", "refs/heads/"+branch, originSHA), action=created, patchAdvanced=true); when both exist and SHAs match -> state=in_sync; when they differ, call git.IsAncestor(ctx, localSHA, originSHA) -- true means fast-forward via update-ref, action=fast_forwarded, patchAdvanced=true

When neither IsAncestor(local,origin) holds nor the SHAs match (diverged): under divergencePolicy=='replace', git.Run(ctx, "update-ref", "refs/hub/replaced/"+branch, localSHA) then git.Run(ctx, "update-ref", "refs/heads/"+branch, originSHA), action=replaced, ReplacedSHA=localSHA, patchAdvanced=true; under 'report', leave the ref untouched and record state=diverged with both SHAs

After any ref move for a branch, call currentCheckout(ctx, git) and if it equals the branch's short name, call git.HardReset(ctx, newTip) immediately so the trunk's working tree matches the moved HEAD

In runCarryPatchSync, call refreshPatchBranchesFromOrigin only when patchBranchSource is origin and the origin fetch of Task 1 succeeded, using the patches already loaded via cfg.PatchStore.ListPatches; for each outcome, call cfg.PatchStore.SetOriginSyncState(ctx, patch.ID, outcomeStatePtr, outcomeSHAPtr, apikit.NowUTC())
When patchBranchSource is hub at the start of the sync, call cfg.PatchStore.ClearOriginSyncState(ctx, slug) once, regardless of whether the sync later returns early
Thread the resulting outcomes []patchSyncOutcome and patchAdvanced bool out of runCarryPatchSync's local scope for use by the rebuild-trigger and response-assembly logic added in Tasks 4 and 5
Run go test ./internal/carrypatch/... -count=1 until TS-02-9..TS-02-16 and TS-02-27 pass

tasks.title: Move the early return past the fork-refresh step and always update last_sync_at
steps: Write TS-02-17..TS-02-20 and confirm they fail

After the Task 3 fork-refresh call returns (outcomes, patchAdvanced), compute the single early-return condition: upstream did not advance AND no patch advanced

Move the UPDATE workspaces SET upstream_head_sha=?, last_sync_at=?, updated_at=? WHERE slug=? write so it always executes once sync reaches this point (both the early-return and continue paths), so last_sync_at advances even on a no-op sync

When the early-return condition holds, return the response immediately after that write with PatchesMerged=[] and RebuildTriggered=false, still carrying OriginFetched/patches_synced/patches_diverged as already computed

When it does not hold, fall through to the existing ListPatches + merge-upstream-detection loop unchanged in logic; add TS-02-20 to prove a branch fast-forwarded this sync is detected merged when its new tip is now an ancestor of upstream

Change the auto-rebuild gate from the old implicit always-true condition to enqueue whenever upstream advanced OR at least one patch advanced, keeping the existing AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_SYNC check, group key and duplicate-suppression logic exactly as-is
Run go test ./internal/carrypatch/... -count=1 until TS-02-17..TS-02-20 pass and the existing pre-spec sync tests in sync_extension_test.go still pass

steps: Write TS-02-21..TS-02-25 and confirm they fail

Add to api.go: PatchesSynced []PatchSyncEntry (json patches_synced, omitempty) and PatchesDiverged []string (json patches_diverged, omitempty) on CarryPatchSyncResponse, plus a PatchSyncEntry struct with BranchName, Action, State, LocalSHA, OriginSHA, and ReplacedSHA (json replaced_sha, omitempty)

In sync_handlers.go, when patchBranchSource is origin, map the Task 3 []patchSyncOutcome into resp.PatchesSynced (one entry per considered patch, replaced_sha set only when Action=='replaced'); when patchBranchSource is hub, leave resp.PatchesSynced nil so the omitempty tag drops the key entirely

Update asExtras() in sync_handlers.go to include origin_fetched always, and patches_synced/patches_diverged only when non-nil, so NewCarryPatchSyncHook's callers see the same shape as handleCarryPatchSyncEndpoint's direct JSON response

In docs/api.md's carry-patch sync section, add rows for origin_fetched, patches_synced (with its object shape) and patches_diverged, and add a 502 origin fetch failed row next to the existing error conditions

In docs/openapi.yaml's CarryPatchSyncResponse schema, add origin_fetched (boolean), patches_synced (array of objects: branch_name, action, state, local_sha, origin_sha, replaced_sha), and patches_diverged (array of strings), and document the 502 response for the sync path
Run go test ./internal/carrypatch/... -count=1 until TS-02-21..TS-02-25 pass

tasks.title: Verify fork-authoritative sync end to end: creation, divergence-replace, and hub-mode unaffected
steps: Write TS-02-32, TS-02-33 and TS-02-34 as //go:build smoke tests in internal/carrypatch (extending smoke_test.go or a new smoke_fork_sync_test.go) against real git repositories, the real jobqueue, real SQLite and the real audit emitter, per each test's real_components; confirm they pass

Trace 02-PATH-1 through the real code: POST /sync -> handleCarryPatchSyncEndpoint -> runCarryPatchSync -> upstream fetch -> PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=origin read -> DefaultOriginFetchFunc -> refreshPatchBranchesFromOrigin creates the branch -> SetOriginSyncState -> emitSyncAudit hub.patch.sync -> rebuild enqueue -> GET /patch-status reflects origin_sync_state and summary counts; confirm no stub remains on this path

Trace 02-PATH-2 the same way for the replace outcome: divergence detection via GitRunner.IsAncestor on resolved SHAs -> refs/hub/replaced/<branch> write -> refs/heads/<branch> move -> hub.patch.replace and hub.patch.sync audit events -> persisted origin_sync_state/origin_sha/origin_synced_at -> patches_synced in the response

Grep internal/carrypatch (sync_handlers.go, origin_fetch.go, fork_refresh.go, api.go, wire.go), internal/workspace (schema.go, patch_store.go, patch_handlers.go, routes.go) and cmd/af-hub/main.go for TODO and panic("not implemented") and remove any that remain
